title: Grilled Garlic and Herb Shrimp
description: Delicious grilled shrimp flavored with a fresh lemon, garlic, paprika, and herb marinade are cooked on a hot grill until juicy, tender, and smoky.
ingredients: 2 teaspoons Italian seasoning, or to taste
2 pounds large shrimp (21-25 per pound), peeled and deveined

steps.text: Whisk paprika, garlic, Italian seasoning, lemon juice, olive oil, pepper, basil, and brown sugar together in a bowl until thoroughly blended.
Stir in shrimp and toss to evenly coat with the marinade. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours, turning once.
Preheat an outdoor grill for medium-high heat. Lightly oil grill grate, and place about 4 inches from heat source.
Remove shrimp from marinade, drain excess, and discard marinade.
Place shrimp on preheated grill and cook, turning once, until opaque in the center, 5 to 6 minutes. Serve immediately.

video.description: You’ll love how a delicate marinade enhances the smoky flavor of these delicious grilled shrimp. Begin with a marinade of paprika, garlic, Italian seasoning, lemon juice, olive oil, pepper, basil and brown sugar. Toss 2 pounds of large shrimp in the sauce and marinate for a couple of hours. Remove from the sauce and put the shrimp on a hot grill and cook until done. It’s that simple! Convince eaters who are resistant to shrimp and blow away dedicated shrimp lovers. This delicious seafood will become a fast favorite and sure to become part of your regular summer grilling repertoire.
